statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The service code billed is CPT 93271
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I47.1
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
CPT 93271 service is medically necessary for extended ambulatory assessment
Cardiac event monitoring is clinically indicated to further characterize arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
